adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the backfill loop builds raw SQL with `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. `h` comes from the `site_settings` value for `embeddable_hosts` (admin-configurable text). Because it is interpolated into a single-quoted SQL string without escaping/quoting, any host containing a `'` will break the SQL syntax and could enable SQL injection in the migration context. Using `ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote(h)` (or prepared statements) would fix this.
